method: Read-only source and recorded-evidence review. No browser, build, or tests launched.

EXT-F-1003-T25.reason: The audit-key card and its inspect/export/filter/re-key controls render only inside Advanced agent capabilities, which SettingsView renders under `isAdmin`. T25 asks a guest to inspect configured audit-key behavior, which crosses that explicit admin-only boundary. This is an applicability correction, not evidence that the audit-key feature passed or failed.
source_evidence: src/features/settings/AuditKeyCard.tsx defines the audit-key display and actions.
EXT-F-1003-T25.recorded_evidence: EXT-F-1003-T22 is separately recorded as passed in guest-settings-002 and accepted by guest-local-evidence-peer: the guest section tree and named Audit key control text were absent. guest-cold-three also records T22 absent after full extension reload. These are evidence for guest visibility denial only, not audit-key operation.
EXT-F-1003-T25.recommended_handling: Keep guest audit-key access represented by the negative-access case T63. Exercise audit-key behavior in an authenticated-admin case; do not count T25 as guest feature coverage.

EXT-F-1003-T63.reason: T63 is the applicable guest/member denial case. T22 provides recorded guest UI evidence for the ordinary Settings rendering path, but T63 additionally covers ordinary members and direct component route/state attempts. No inspected evidence proves those additional dimensions.
source_evidence: SettingsView.tsx gates the Advanced agent capabilities section on `isAdmin`.

AdvancedAgentCapabilities is exported and contains no local auth/admin guard; the inspected source has no separate route to it. The normal Settings gate is therefore source-evident, while direct mounting/state manipulation has no recorded runtime proof here.
EXT-F-1003-T63.recorded_evidence: guest-settings-002 and guest-cold-three cover T22 for a guest, including absence after reload. The peer review limits its acceptance to the recorded T22 criteria. No member run or direct-component attempt was found in the inspected artifacts.
open_gaps: Ordinary member denial in the live Settings UI remains unverified by this evidence set.
Direct component/state access denial remains unverified; the source component itself does not enforce the auth boundary, and no separate route was found.
No claim is made here about backend authorization or audit-key data protection.

EXT-F-1003-T22.reason: Prior records observe the restricted section and named controls absent for a guest in warm/reload UI states. This establishes the guest-facing negative visibility criterion, not member coverage or bypass resistance.
